name: OptimToken
description: Compare LLM API pricing, estimate workload costs, and benchmark cloud compute. By OptimNow.

tools.name: compare-llm-models
tools.title: Compare LLM Models
tools.description: Compare AI/LLM models by price, quality (ELO), efficiency, and capabilities. Fetches live data from OpenRouter API. Filter by provider, category, capability, price range, or minimum ELO score. Optionally enrich with business metrics for a use case. Reports both list-price cost and the optimized cost achievable with prompt caching and the batch API. IMPORTANT: Report all prices, costs, and scores EXACTLY as returned. Do NOT add commentary, opinions, or recommendations beyond what the data shows. Present the results as a table and let the user draw conclusions.

category.description: Filter by category: Frontier, Mid-tier, Budget, Open Weights, Image

capability.description: Filter by capability: Text, Vision, Code, Reasoning, Agents, Image Gen, Audio

maxInputPrice.description: Max input price per 1M tokens in USD

maxOutputPrice.description: Max output price per 1M tokens in USD

minElo.description: Minimum ELO score (quality benchmark from Chatbot Arena)

useCasePreset.description: Use case for cost estimation. Default: supportTicket

tools.name: estimate-llm-cost
tools.title: Estimate LLM Cost
tools.description: Estimate per-request and monthly costs for AI/LLM models across different use cases and volumes. Provide a model name to get detailed cost breakdowns, or compare costs across all use case presets. Each figure comes twice: list price, and the optimized price achievable with prompt caching and the batch API. IMPORTANT: Report all cost figures EXACTLY as returned. Do NOT add commentary or recommendations beyond the data.

modelName.description: Model name to estimate costs for (e.g. 'GPT-4o', 'Claude Sonnet 4'). If omitted, shows top models.

useCasePreset.description: Use case preset. Default: all presets.

customInputTokens.description: Custom input tokens per request (overrides preset)

customOutputTokens.description: Custom output tokens per request (overrides preset)

tools.name: compare-models-side-by-side
tools.title: Compare Models Side by Side
tools.description: Put 2 to 4 named AI/LLM models side by side across all 8 business use cases, with cost per request and monthly cost at list price and at the optimized price (prompt caching, plus the batch API where the workload allows it). The `resolution` array says how each requested name was matched — report any not-found, ambiguous or duplicate entry to the user verbatim. IMPORTANT: Report all costs EXACTLY as returned. Do NOT add commentary or recommendations beyond the data.

models.description: 2 to 4 model names to place side by side. Each is matched as a substring of the model or provider name (e.g. ['GPT-4o', 'Claude Sonnet 4']).

tools.name: recommend-llm-model
tools.title: Recommend an LLM Model
tools.description: Rank AI/LLM models for one workload and volume under optional constraints (max monthly budget, minimum ELO, required capability, open weights only) and return the top 3. The output is FACTS ONLY — efficiency rank, ELO, list and optimized monthly cost, FinOps Friendly flag, volatility risk, and a per-constraint satisfied/violated breakdown. Write the narrative yourself from those facts. When no model satisfies every constraint, `overConstrained` is true and `nearMisses` holds the closest models with the specific constraint each one failed. `roiCalculatorUrl` is a deep link to the OptimNow AI ROI Calculator carrying this scenario — offer it to the user as a clickable link in your reply, since the in-widget link may be blocked by the host's iframe sandbox. IMPORTANT: Report all figures EXACTLY as returned. Do NOT invent reasons the data does not contain.

useCasePreset.description: The workload to rank models for

maxMonthlyBudget.description: Maximum monthly spend in USD, checked against the LIST-price monthly cost (not the optimized one)

requiredCapability.description: Capability the model must have: Text, Vision, Code, Reasoning, Agents, Image Gen, Audio

openWeightsOnly.description: Only consider models under a non-proprietary licence

tools.name: compare-compute-pricing
tools.title: Compare Cloud Compute Pricing
tools.description: Compare cloud compute instance pricing across AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, OCI, OVH, and Alibaba. Filter by provider, vCPUs, memory, category, processor, or use case. All prices are Linux on-demand list prices in USD. IMPORTANT: Report all prices EXACTLY as returned. Do NOT add commentary or recommendations beyond the data.

provider.description: Cloud provider: AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, OCI, OVH, Alibaba

category.description: Instance category: General Purpose, Compute Optimized, Memory Optimized, Storage Optimized, GPU / Accelerated, Burstable

processor.description: Processor filter: Intel, AMD, Graviton, Ampere, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, etc.

useCase.description: Use case filter: Web App, Database, HPC, ML & AI, Dev/Test, Big Data

sortBy.description: Sort by: price, vcpus, memory, pricePerVCPU. Default: price
